shortDescription: Manage Metal Gateway in Equinix Metal

options.name: ip_reservation_id
options.description: UUID of Public Reservation to associate with the gateway, the reservation must be in the same metro as the VLAN, conflicts with private_ipv4_subnet_size.

options.name: private_ipv4_subnet_size
options.description: Size of the private IPv4 subnet to create for this metal gateway, must be one of 8, 16, 32, 64, 128. Conflicts with ip_reservation_id.

options.name: project_id
options.description: UUID of the project where the gateway is scoped to.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for gateway to get to "ready" state, and for gateway to be removed

options.name: virtual_network_id
options.description: UUID of the VLAN where the gateway is scoped to.
